title: fix(console): an injected @objectstack/client joins the vendor-objectstack chunk group (objectui#10920)
body:
Fixes #10920

## What broke

objectstack's `build-console.sh` always sets `OBJECTSTACK_CLIENT_DIST` to the framework's own `packages/client`. That path is outside `node_modules`, so the `vendor-objectstack` group test never matched the injected client. Before #9488 the recursive `data-adapter` group absorbed the client anyway, which hid the gap. Once #9488 made `data-adapter` non-recursive, the client landed in `framework`.

`framework` imports `data-adapter`, through `packages/react`'s `error-message.ts`. `data-adapter` then `require`s the CJS client from `framework` at its top level, before `framework` has defined it. On `9f0c84a44` the console built this way stays on the splash screen with `TypeError: u is not a function`.

## The fix

`widenVendorChunkTestForClient` widens the group's test with the injected client's package directory. The spec hook already does the same for an injected spec. When nothing is injected, the test is returned unchanged, so production and CI builds do not move.

## Evidence

- Reverse verification: the three new cases pass. With `vendorObjectstackTest` wired back to the bare expression, only the config-level case fails (1 red, 21 green). That case is the one that pins the wiring.
- `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/vite-objectstack-client-dist.test.ts`: 22 passed.
- `pnpm type-check:scripts` and `pnpm type-check:vitest-config`: clean.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: no changeset is owed, because no published source moved.
- End to end, with the same change applied to objectstack's build tree at `9f0c84a44`: `chunk-membership.json` reads `client: { "vendor-objectstack": 1 }`, the console boots to `/login`, and a 95-surface sweep of the showcase and Setup apps shows no page errors.
